source: Seeded from Providence roadmap and F:\Realmz Scenario Utility\docs\scenario-format

targets.title: Scenario shell, startup, and release
targets.latestEvidence: Marker/main scenario file layout is source-backed for startup fields, registration code segments, and creator/user Str255; Data CI is eighteen Str255 fields; Data RI is a 320-byte party restriction record; setupnewgame first-start source files are identified.
targets.restrictionEvidence: Data RI stores one Str255 description, maxpc, maxlevel, 30 banned-race flags, and 30 banned-caste flags used by partyselect.

targets.title: Map tile intelligence
targets.latestEvidence: Data Solids is special negative tile solidity; standard land tile semantics are source-backed in landlook mapstats * BD files; raw Data LD field values now have source-backed layers for terrain, negative icons, positive thousand-band state, note/path bits, and secret/action normalization; Data RD random rectangles are source-backed as 644-byte randlevel records; dark/LOS flags are authored but visible exploration state is generated CL site cache.

targets.title: Dungeon geometry and interaction bits
targets.latestEvidence: Data DL is a dungeon bitfield; source-backed masks now cover wall, door orientation, stair, pillar, hidden/revealed secret state, directional pass-through, and interaction evidence.

targets.title: Core records for full scenario construction
targets.latestEvidence: Scenario-authored records are separated from shared/override rules data; item definitions are shared-library evidence in this pass, while Data Race/Data Caste have source-backed scenario override behavior.
targets.textEvidence: Data SD2 is a central 256-byte Str255 message pool; Data ED/Data ED2 inline buffers are encounter display text, not executable syntax.
targets.monsterEvidence: Data MD is a 210-byte monster template file; battle grids index it directly, Data MENU is generated from it, spawn/add-ally actions consume it, and todoondeath executes a death macro.
targets.battleEvidence: Data BD is a 346-byte battle record with a 13x13 signed monster grid, before/after message ids, randomized distance, and sign-sensitive combat-round macro behavior.
targets.itemTreasureShopEvidence: Data TD is a 48-byte source treasure record; Data SD is a 3002-byte source shop record copied to runtime CS; item IDs resolve through five 200-record item families.
targets.encounterEvidence: Data ED/Data ED2 are source simple/complex encounter records copied to runtime CE/CE2; complex encounters have distinct action, word, group, spell, item, and thief fields.
targets.thiefTimedEvidence: Data TD2 is a 118-byte thief/rogue encounter source copied to runtime CT; Data TD3 is a 40-byte timed encounter source copied to runtime CTD3 and gated by day, percent, item, quest, and location.
targets.rulesEvidence: Spells are 30-byte byte-only records with packed IDs; scenario Data Race overrides are 408-byte records; Data Caste records are 576 bytes; Rules UI should show shared-vs-scenario override badges.
targets.mapRecordEvidence: Data MD2 is a 340-byte map record with ten cicn marker triples, preview start fields, optional PICT-backed display, land/dungeon target, clip rectangle, and Str255 note text.

targets.title: Scripts and runtime state semantics
targets.latestEvidence: Global is a 60-byte file of 30 signed-short macro hook slots; source-backed runtime consumers are start game, party death, end/quit game, before shop, and before temple.

targets.corpusFrequency: resource fork present in corpus; observed 8836 typed resources
